This is a lesson on one drum groove the [Backing Track](../../tools/backing-track.qmd) band plays: **Light time**. It is built up from a simpler pattern, one step at a time, and every step is played by the band and written out as it plays. How the examples work: press ▶ Play, switch players in and out with the buttons beside it, and read the band's last four bars on the staff underneath. The tempo slider at the bottom of the page slows everything down.

[All the accompaniment patterns](index.qmd) · [Drum grooves](index.qmd#drums)

## The pattern

Very quiet eighths on the hi-hat, a soft kick on 1 and 3 and a light cross-stick on 2 and 4. No fills. A stand-in for brushes.

It belongs in *Folk carol*, *Acoustic strum*, *Boom-chick* and *Piano ballad*. Here it is in the folk carol style with the whole band. Switch the other players off to hear it alone.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="carol" data-chart="G|C|D|G" data-tempo="96" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Drum groove:" data-choices='[{"label":"Light time","opts":{"groove":"brushes"}}]'></div>

## Step 1: Hi-hat: eighth notes

Start with something simpler. Closed hi-hat on every eighth note, all of one weight, kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4. The basic rock beat. In 3/4: six eighths, kick on 1, snare on 3.

This is a pattern of its own: [the lesson on it](drums-hheighths.qmd) takes it further. Here it is only a step on the way, slowly. The drums play alone first; switch the bass and chords on when it is steady.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="carol" data-chart="G|C|D|G" data-tempo="68" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Step:" data-choices='[{"label":"Hi-hat: eighth notes","opts":{"groove":"hheighths"}}]'></div>

## Step 2: Light time, slowly

Now the pattern itself. Compare it with the step before: press each button while the band plays and watch what changes on the staff.

**How to play it.** Very quiet hat eighths, soft kick on 1 and 3, light cross-stick on 2 and 4. No fills. Stay under the singer.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="carol" data-chart="G|C|D|G" data-tempo="68" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Compare:" data-choices='[{"label":"Light time","opts":{"groove":"brushes"}},{"label":"Hi-hat: eighth notes (the step before)","opts":{"groove":"hheighths"}}]'></div>

The whole band, at 96 beats a minute. Play along, then switch the band's drum kit off and take the part yourself.
